result.summary: This PR adds and improves debug/trace-level logging for compact block (cmpctblock) reconstruction: it logs sizes and counts of transactions sourced from prefill, mempool, and extrapool, logs redundant prefilled transactions and their source, and adds trace-level logging of transaction IDs that are missing or requested via GETBLOCKTXN. It is split off from #35558 (prefill compact blocks) to make reconstruction performance observable ahead of that larger change. No consensus or wire-protocol behavior is altered, only logging and some internal counting refactors in blockencodings.cpp/h and net_processing.cpp.
result.problem: Developers and operators debugging compact block reconstruction currently have limited visibility into where reconstructed transactions come from and how much redundancy exists in prefills, making it hard to evaluate or tune the reconstruction logic (including the upcoming prefill series in #35558).

open_concerns: andrewtoth suggested a cleaner data structure (map-based) to track redundant prefills that avoids repeatedly taking the mempool lock inside a loop via pool->exists; author has not yet implemented this and confirmed on 2026-09-16 he still needs to integrate it with other in-flight work.
0xB10C is withholding an ACK until andrewtoth's suggestion is addressed, and left several nits (log message formatting, missing block hash in one log line, reusing debug_log variable).
resolved_concerns: w0xlt's original concern about incorrect decrement logic for collided extrapool/mempool transactions was resolved after #35727 merged and the PR was reworked on top of it.
w0xlt's contradictory log level (LogDebug inside a ShouldTraceLog check) was fixed by switching to LogTrace.
0xB10C's suggestion to combine per-txid log lines into one line was implemented.
Naming and minor readability nits from 0xB10C and andrewtoth were fixed in a later push.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: The PR changes compact block (cmpctblock) reconstruction logic and logging in blockencodings.cpp/h and net_processing.cpp, which is core p2p relay code.
categories.rationale: P4 because the change is purely diagnostic logging around compact block reconstruction with no change to relay correctness, DoS resistance, or protocol behavior. It has minor leverage as groundwork for observing the in-progress prefill series (#35558) per the description ('makes it easier to observe compact block reconstruction performance'), but that benefit is limited to developers debugging that feature, not end users or node operators broadly.

uncertainties: Whether the project considers observability for the prefill series (#35558) important enough to elevate this beyond a routine logging PR is not stated by any maintainer beyond the author's own framing.
It's unclear whether andrewtoth's outstanding suggestion will require a substantial rewrite that invalidates most of the current diff, or just a localized change to the redundant-prefill tracking.
